title: Dugout Dice - My First Game Ever
author: --Clintoris--
selftext:
I work in finance, have needy kids, coach and have very limited coding experience. 

  
But every now and then I get weirdly, hyper obsessed (hyperfocus) with games, the most recent two:

  
Dicey Dungeons

Balatro

  
I always thought these games combined in a baseball setting would be fun. So over the last few weeks I've been building Dugout Dice for myself to play. My kids starting playing it and got really into it and pushed for me to send it out there. 

It's made for portrait mode on mobile, everything else out there is seemingly landscape so I wanted to keep it more natural with a phone in your hands. 

  
My ultimate goal would be push to IOS/Android and have it there for free. But not if it sucks. 

Any chance anyone wants to give it a try and give feedback and if it's enjoyable? None of my friends really care. 

  
[https://dugout-dice.com/](https://dugout-dice.com/)

  
Thank you! 

  
P.S - if anyone likes it I can give you some cheat codes to unlock stuff

  
P.P.S - you can tell I'm over 40 because I used P.S

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body: This looks pretty promising but it needs a better intro. I definitely got dropped into the game without really understanding how to play.

comments.body: I second the first comment, my first roll I had no idea what i was doing but quickly got the hand of it. Honestly great idea and quite addicting I would definitely keep polishing this and adding more chase goals to purchase etc
